name: Wi-Fi Clipboard Sync v1.0.5
changelog:
🚀 Stability & Camera Fix Release (v1.0.5):
- Fixed Android camera crash caused by accessibility service triggering on camera shutter / cutout view events
- Added strict package filtering for camera, launcher, and home apps to avoid unsolicited sync
- Fixed auto pop-up & screen flashing issues on Android
- Luminescent Connection Orb & Obsidian Glass UI
- 100% automated in-app updates for both Android and Windows
⚠️ Note for v1.0.1 users: Please uninstall v1.0.1 once before installing.
